narrative.overview: inphner should feel like a tidy desk at home where you practise: personal, light, everything in reach, nothing shouting. Frosted panels sit over a soft, slowly drifting wallpaper the way papers sit on a wooden desk. The one big thing on the desk is the time; every other object is small, quiet and put away until you reach for it. The system grew out of inphub's Glass design and was made plainer in v1.4.0, because the glossy original read as obviously AI-made. Controls are soft and tactile: gently rounded, flat fills, a small spring on press.
keyCharacteristics: Frosted, fairly solid glass panels over a soft wallpaper with a fine grain.
One big rounded, tabular time; everything else small and calm.
Flat accent fills, hairline borders, small tight shadows.
A small spring on press; nothing moves on its own except the wallpaper drift.
Light + forest + green by default; dark, eight more accents and reduced transparency fully supported.

rules.name: The Plain Colour Rule
rules.body: --bg, --text-dim, --border, --accent, --good, --warn, --bad and --purple stay plain colours, never color-mix(): Chart.js reads them at draw time. Only derived tints (--accent-soft, badge backgrounds) are mixed.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Green and amber on the time mean "ready" and "armed". Don't reuse them for decoration anywhere a cuber might glance mid-hold.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every time, average, count or clock uses the rounded face with tabular figures, so numbers never shift sideways as they change.

rules.name: The 16px Field Rule
rules.body: Form fields are at least 16px, or iOS zooms in on focus.

rules.name: The No Glass-in-Glass Rule
rules.body: Inside a panel, use Fill 1/2/3. A glass panel never sits inside another.

rules.name: The Clean Ancestor Rule
rules.body: Only <html> paints a background, overlays put their tint and blur on ::before, and no transform/filter (or forwards/both animation fill) stays on an ancestor of a glass panel. Any of those silently stops the blur.

dos: Do use the tokens (--accent, --glass-bg, --fill-*, --radius-*) for every colour, fill and corner.
Do put hover effects inside @media (hover: hover) and give every pressable thing the small spring.
Do check every change light and dark, with reduced transparency, at 1378×862 and at 375px.
Do keep the time the only large element on the timer screen.
Do honour prefers-reduced-motion; motion collapses to near-instant.
donts: Don't bring back inphub's sheen, hover glow, gradient-filled buttons or logo, or glossy icon tiles (the v1.4.0 decision).
Don't give body, .app, .main or .view a background; it hides the wallpaper.
Don't hardcode a translucent background or a raw hex outside badge tints, cube stickers, white knobs and #fff in mixes.
Don't animate the timer's colour changes.
Don't add perpetual motion; the wallpaper drift is the only thing that moves on its own, and it pauses while timing.
